name: 08b-mat-start
prompt: Edit this exact calm GTA San Andreas PS2 physio frame. name: 08b-mat-end
prompt: Create the END pose of this same gentle assisted side stretch. Keep the two women, faces, outfits, camera, background, equipment, lighting, mat and all room geometry exactly unchanged. The maroon woman now leans her ribcage and head further DOWN toward screen LEFT, lowering her left shoulder toward her planted left hand and bringing the overhead fingertips farther left and lower. name: 04-bail-end
prompt: Create a single GTA San Andreas PS2 action keyframe, using image 1 as the exact camera/environment/car reference and image 2 ONLY as the woman identity and clothing reference. Same blue taxi on the kerb, open front right driver door, rooted grey lamp post, mall facade, daytime. This is a PRE-IMPACT BAILOUT, NOT a crash or windscreen ejection. The woman has just launched sideways out through the OPEN FRONT DRIVER DOOR. She is now fully OUTSIDE the car on the pavement on the RIGHT foreground, torso pitched forward and down, knees tucked, both feet clear of the sill, arms reaching toward the pavement to begin a shoulder tumble. Keep her whole body visible with generous space below. She wears MAROON FULL-LENGTH LEGGINGS and matching sleeveless maroon yoga top, black ponytail, WHITE athletic trainers, exactly as image 2; no skirt, no shorts, no heels, no handbag. Empty front driver seat visible through door. Every window remains intact. Taxi retains rigid unchanged geometry and continues forward toward but still SHORT OF the lamp post, with a clear gap between bumper and pole. Camera follows slightly toward the woman but remains rear three-quarter, no front view. No blood, no injury, no HUD.
